scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal

rubricScores.criterion: Found the MSB3073 error in the DataSources project's signing step and identified the specific file(s) that failed
Traced the failing file to its origin — placed in shared folder by a different project
Discovered multiple projects share the same Distrib path
Identified CAS read-only hard links making files unsignable
Proposed removing Distrib/Robocopy from library projects so only service project owns the folder
Verified fix would make each project sign only its own files

scenarios.reasoning: Strong, well-evidenced investigation that nails the error, the foreign file, the shared Distrib anti-pattern, and offers concrete fixes. Weakest point is the read-only mechanism: it did not establish the CAS/read-only hard-link cause and instead offered a partly speculative lock/attribute story, and one proposed property flag appears fabricated rather than verified from the targets file.
